content.description: Exploded view of alternator assembly showing rotor installation to drive end frame

items: INSTALL ROTOR TO DRIVE END FRAME
Using a plastic hammer, lightly tap the rear end frame onto the drive end frame.

content.description: Diagram showing pulley installation with SST A and SST B tools positioned on alternator

items: Install the pulley to the rotor shaft by tightening the pulley nut by hand.
Hold SST A with a torque wrench and tighten SST B clockwise to the specified torque.

content.description: Diagram showing SST C mounting in vise and pulley torquing procedure with SST A

items: Check that SST A is secured to the pulley shaft.
As shown in the figure, mount SST C in a vise and then install the alternator to SST C.
To torque the pulley, nut turn SST A in the direction shown in the figure.
Remove the alternator from SST C.
Turn SST B and remove SSTs A and B.

content.description: Diagram showing installation of four rubber insulators on alternator lead wires

items: Install the four rubber insulators on the lead wires.

content.description: Diagram showing rectifier installation with four screws

items: Install the rectifier with four screws.
